glue.description: a client wrapper that reads the outcome carrier (Cedar's applying policy annotation from the verbose diagnostics, or Cerbos's output block) and returns it as the decision, plus the absence guards the translator already writes

notes: Observed by the real system in the Phase 2 conformance run: escalate_human (expected escalate_human). Carrier: annotation (Cedar decides ALLOW or DENY; the outcome rides an @outcome annotation on the one permit that applied, read from `authorize -v` diagnostics). Worker requested vs policy selected escalation: only by the policy id in the diagnostics (r1 vs r4/r8); no system level cause.
